policy: Chinese latest-manual source is primary; only source-bound reviewed translations, never generic fallback.

translations.source_text_zh: 地面：为防止可能的干扰，对离港飞机，直到收到进入或者对 正跑道指令才打开 TCAS；对于进港飞机，直到脱离跑道再关闭。
translations.original_text_en: To prevent potential interference, TCAS should remain activated for departing aircraft until receiving the go-to or go-around command, and deactivated for arriving aircraft until the aircraft has left the runway.
translations.text_en: To prevent possible interference, activate TCAS for departing aircraft only after receiving clearance to enter or line up on the runway. For arriving aircraft, do not deactivate TCAS until the aircraft has vacated the runway.
translations.review_note: 以已逐页核实的中文为依据修正动作/时序或五边术语误译；不改变数字、适用条件或新增操作建议。

translations.source_text_zh: 离场：为减少跑道占用时间，飞行员应确保在收到起飞 许可后能立即开始起飞滑跑。
translations.original_text_en: To minimize runway time, pilots must ensure they can begin taxiing immediately upon receiving the takeoff clearance.
translations.text_en: To reduce runway occupancy time, ensure that the takeoff roll can begin immediately after receipt of takeoff clearance.
translations.review_note: 以已逐页核实的中文为依据修正动作/时序或五边术语误译；不改变数字、适用条件或新增操作建议。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：航图新增Z 进近程序为主用程序，数据库也有变化，提 示机组注意阅读对应进场图中Warning 中的说明，避免未经 ATC 许可转向五边加入进近程序。
translations.original_text_en: The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. Crews are advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.
translations.text_en: The new Z approach procedure is the primary procedure, and the navigation database has also changed. Carefully review the Warning notes on the corresponding arrival chart. Do not turn onto final approach to join the approach procedure without ATC clearance.
translations.review_note: 以已逐页核实的中文为依据修正动作/时序或五边术语误译；不改变数字、适用条件或新增操作建议。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。
translations.original_text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.
translations.text_en: When flying the VTBS 20R RNP approach, pay particular attention after ATKIN on the turn to final. ATC may instruct: "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." This requires first establishing on the 20R RNP final approach course; it is not clearance for the RNP approach. Confirm the instruction to avoid inadvertently arming APPR. ATC will subsequently clear descent to 3500ft and clear the RNP20R approach. This can result in high energy; plan ahead to prevent an unstable approach. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.
translations.review_note: 逐句保留先建立五边而非进近许可、证实指令、APPR、随后下降许可与能量风险。高截获保留原英文引号术语，不推断新程序。

translations.source_text_zh: 离场：离地后自动脱波联系进近，具体频率由放行给出。
translations.original_text_en: The aircraft automatically disengages from the wave contact after leaving the ground and approaches, with the specific frequency provided by the air traffic control.
translations.text_en: After becoming airborne, change to Approach on the frequency provided by Clearance Delivery.
translations.review_note: 中文明确离地后联系进近、频率由放行给出；按该条件直接表述为换频指令，不宣称航空器有自动换频系统。

translations.source_text_zh: 离场：离地自动脱波119.25。
translations.original_text_en: Automatic wave separation from the ground 119.25.
translations.text_en: Immediately after take-off, contact Suvarnabhumi Departure on 119.25 MHz before transfer to the relevant approach sector, unless instructed otherwise by ATC.
translations.review_note: CAAT当前有效2026-10-01期VTBS AD 2.22第6.1条补足公司中文缩写：离地立即联系Departure、119.25MHz、转交进近扇区之前及ATC例外。非航空器自动换频功能。保留公司中英文原文，2026-10-29起须重新核查有效权威依据。

authority_evidence.summary_zh: 所有离港航空器离地后立即联系Suvarnabhumi Departure，频率119.25MHz；移交相关进近扇区之前完成，ATC另有指令时除外。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：本场西面及西南面有山13 号五边有低矮孤立山包天 气不好时从西面进场飞机注意扇区最低安全高度及航路安全高 度限制。栎社NDB 和宁波VOR 故障时，31号EOSID 不可用，注 意13号VOR/DME 进近五边航迹和跑道有4 度夹角。13号 VOR 下降梯度5.7％，换算成 FPA3.26。
translations.original_text_en: The 13th mountain is located west and southwest of this field, with a low, isolated hillon itsfive sides. During adverse weather conditions, aircraft entering from the west must adhere to the sector's minimum safe altitude and route safety restrictions. When the Leshan NDB and Ningbo VOR are out of service, the 31st EOSID becomes unavailable. Note that the 13th VOR/DME approach five sides form a 4-degree angle with the runway. The 13th VOR has a descent gradient of 5.7%, equivalent to a FPA of 3.26.
translations.text_en: Terrain lies west and southwest of the aerodrome, with a low isolated hill on final approach to Runway 13. In poor weather, aircraft approaching from the west must observe the sector minimum safe altitude and en-route safe-altitude restrictions. When the Lishe NDB and Ningbo VOR are unserviceable, the Runway 31 EOSID is unavailable. The final approach track for the Runway 13 VOR/DME approach is offset by 4 degrees from the runway. The Runway 13 VOR descent gradient is 5.7%, equivalent to FPA 3.26.
translations.review_note: 逐页核对中文581及英文1352-1353；13号修饰跑道及五边，不修饰山。完整保留西/西南、低矮孤立山包、西侧坏天气条件、最低安全高度限制、NDB/VOR故障条件、31号EOSID、13号VOR/DME夹角4度及5.7%/FPA3.26；不添加运行要求。

translations.source_text_zh: 低空因乱流影响，易导致低空坡度大。
translations.original_text_en: Low-altitude turbulence can easily cause significant slope effects in the lower air layers.
translations.text_en: Low-altitude turbulence can result in large bank angles at low altitude.
translations.review_note: 对照本条记录所列20261019中英文原始页核实；仅修明确误译，保留条件、动作、数值与单位，不增补操作要求。

translations.source_text_zh: 因入口内移动和乱流影响，易导致接地前下降率过大。
translations.original_text_en: Due to internal movement and turbulence at the entrance, excessive pre-grounding descent rate may occur.
translations.text_en: A displaced threshold and turbulence can result in an excessive descent rate before touchdown.

translations.text_en: The Runway 13 threshold is displaced by 150m; note the visual effect.

translations.source_text_zh: 13号盲降不工作时，使用 RNP13进近，且航图程序 只有LNAV。
translations.original_text_en: When the 13th blind landing is not operational, use RNP13 approach with only LNAV in the chart program.
translations.text_en: When the Runway 13 ILS is unserviceable, use the RNP13 approach; the published procedure provides LNAV only.

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：三亚分别有盲降Y和Z两种程序，需提前收听通波确认，通常为Z程序，但是管制通常不会指明使用哪一种，请机组 注意，避免飞错。
translations.original_text_en: Sanya has two emergency landing procedures (Y and Z), both requiring prior radio confirmation. While Z procedure is typically used, air traffic control rarely specifies which one to follow. Crews should remain vigilant to avoid misapplication.
translations.text_en: There are two ILS procedures, Y and Z. Listen to the broadcast in advance to confirm which procedure is in use. The Z procedure is normally used, but ATC generally does not specify which one; take care to avoid flying the wrong procedure.

translations.text_en: Turbulence on final approach.

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：1.26号跑道进近飞机较多时，指挥下高度偏晚，机组注 意及时减速控制飞机能量。
translations.original_text_en: When there are many aircraft approaching Runway 1.26, the command may delay the altitude control, and the crew should promptly reduce speed to control the aircraft's energy.
translations.text_en: When arrival traffic for Runway 26 is heavy, ATC may issue descent clearance late. Reduce speed in good time to manage aircraft energy.
translations.review_note: 对照本条记录所列20261019中英文原始页核实；仅修明确误译，保留条件、动作、数值与单位。中文原页跑道26前的1.是条目序号。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：有机组反馈，舟山方向进场，通过一万尺，RADIONAV 页面会自动调谐宁波盲降频率，但是PFD 左下角可能会显示调 谐出浦东IPR 的盲降信号，飞近宁波后恢复正常，请机组注意 检查，切勿飞错盲降频率。
translations.original_text_en: During the approach to Zhoushan, the RADIONAV page will automatically tune to Ningbo's blind landing frequency after 10,000 feet.However, the PFD may display the Pudong IPR's blind landing signal in the lower left corner. Once approaching Ningbo, the frequency will reset to normal. The crew must verify this and avoid misfiring the blind landing frequency.
translations.text_en: On an approach from the Zhoushan direction, after passing 10,000ft, the RADIONAV page automatically tunes the Ningbo ILS frequency, but the lower left corner of the PFD may display the Pudong IPR ILS signal. Normal indications return nearer Ningbo. Check the indications carefully and do not fly the wrong ILS frequency.
translations.review_note: 对照本条记录所列20261019中英文原始页核实；仅修明确误译，保留条件、动作、数值与单位，不增补操作要求。

translations.source_text_zh: 离场：08号常用PORAP-1N，通常放行中会要求7200M过 PORAP，性能一般可以满足。
translations.original_text_en: The commonly used PORAP-1N model (model 08) typically requires a 7200M PORAP during release procedures, and its performance generally meets the requirements. When troops are active, they may depart traditionally, and note the speed limit of PORAP. The aircraft ishanded over to the Sanya District Air Traffic Control Center for command, which sets the RVSM (Real-Time Vertical Management System) altitude and instructsthe aircraft toreach the designated position before NUMKU.
translations.text_en: PORAP-1N is commonly used for Runway 08. Departure clearance usually requires crossing PORAP at 7200m, and performance is generally sufficient. When military activity is present, a conventional departure may be used; observe the PORAP speed restriction. After transfer to Sanya Area Control, ATC instructs a climb to an RVSM level and requires that level to be reached before NUMKU.
translations.review_note: 中文1008及英文1594-1595逐页核对：英文把三条离场内容合并为一段。逐条保存中文原文、ID、页码和哈希；修正model及RVSM错误全称，保留08、PORAP-1N、7200m、部队活动条件、速度限制、区调与NUMKU之前到达的时序。

additional_chinese_sources.text: 离场：当部队活动时，可能会传统离场，且注意PORAP的速度 限制。
离场：离港交给三亚区调会指挥上RVSM高度，并且指令NUMKU 之前到达。

translations.source_text_zh: 地面：B9灯牌在跑道一侧,13 号落地后通常指挥在B10 前 等，后续通常B9左转跟引导车，注意B9 紧邻B10(B10 灯牌在 机坪一侧)，容易错过。
translations.original_text_en: The B9 light sign is positioned on one side of the runway. After landing atgate 13, pilots are typically instructed to wait in front of B10. The B9 usually turns left to follow the lead vehicle, but it'simportant to note that B9 is right next to B10 (the B10 light sign is on the apron side), which can easily cause pilots to miss it.
translations.text_en: The B9 sign is on the runway side. After landing on Runway 13, ATC usually instructs a wait before B10, followed by a left turn at B9 to follow the guide vehicle. Note that B9 is immediately next to B10, whose sign is on the apron side, and can easily be missed.
translations.review_note: 对照本条记录所列20261019中英文原始页核实；仅修明确误译，保留条件、动作、数值与单位，不增补操作要求。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：13号跑道进近贴着地形下降，视觉可能会有错觉影 响，受风和地形影响，五边常有顺风且气流比较乱，13号跑道 入口内移150m。
translations.original_text_en: The approach to Runway 13 follows the terrain, which may cause visual illusions. Due to wind and terrain effects,the five sides often experience tailwinds with chaotic airflow. The runway entrance has been moved inward by 150 meters.
translations.text_en: The Runway 13 approach descends close to terrain and may cause visual illusions. Due to wind and terrain, tailwinds and turbulent airflow are common on final. The Runway 13 threshold is displaced by 150m.
translations.review_note: 对照本条记录所列20261019中英文原始页核实；仅修明确误译，保留条件、动作、数值与单位，不增补操作要求。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：宁波13 号进近，五边经常有尾风，加上五边有地 形，可能会触发GPWS警告，建议如遇顺风，建议机组设置形态 2，速度160 节。
translations.original_text_en: During Ningbo 13 approach, tailwinds frequently occur at the five-bank area. Given the terrain at thislocation, GPWS warnings may be triggered. For tailwinds, crews should set Mode 2 with a speed of 160 knots.
translations.text_en: On the Runway 13 approach, tailwinds are frequent on final. Together with terrain on final, this may trigger GPWS warnings. If a tailwind is encountered, configuration 2 and a speed of 160 knots are recommended.
translations.review_note: 对照本条记录所列20261019中英文原始页核实；仅修明确误译，保留条件、动作、数值与单位，不增补操作要求。

translations.source_text_zh: 运行特点：单发程序：13号跑道有PBN EOSID，31号跑道有PBN EOSID和传统 EOSID。双发减推力高度和加速高度，以及单发加 速高度参考EFB 相应单发程序描述进行输入。
translations.original_text_en: Single-launch program: Runway 13 isequipped with PBN EOSID; Runway 31 is equipped with both PBN EOSID and conventional EOSID.Derated thrust altitude, acceleration altitude for all-engines-operating condition, and acceleration altitude for engine- out condition shall be entered in accordance with the corresponding engine-out procedures specified in the EFB.
translations.text_en: Runway 13 has a PBN engine-out departure procedure (EOSID); Runway 31 has both a PBN EOSID and a conventional EOSID. Enter the all-engines-operating thrust-reduction and acceleration altitudes, and the engine-out acceleration altitude, in accordance with the corresponding engine-out procedure descriptions in the EFB.
translations.review_note: 对照本条记录所列20261019中英文原始页核实；仅修明确误译，保留条件、动作、数值与单位，不增补操作要求。

translations.source_text_zh: 运行特点：滑出有时跟引导车；若无引导车，尤其夜间需仔细观察 道口指示标识与机坪飞机，A3滑行道夜间辨识度较差。
translations.original_text_en: Roll-out operations may require a guide vehicle; in the absence of such guidance, particularly at night, close monitoring of approach path markings and aircraft on the apron is essential, as the A3 taxiway exhibits reduced visibilityduring nighttime operations.
translations.text_en: A guide vehicle is sometimes used when taxiing out. Without a guide vehicle, particularly at night, carefully observe taxiway signs and aircraft on the apron; Taxiway A3 is difficult to identify at night.

translations.source_text_zh: 地面：曼谷的 s126机位的进位引导经常跳变，会出现瞬间从 2 米调到 0 然后出现 stop，ok 后又会跳变出数字，有滑过或者未 滑行到位的风险，机组和机务都多次遇到此类情况。
translations.original_text_en: At Terminal S126 in Bangkok, the approach guidance system frequently exhibits abrupt switching: it may instantaneously shift from 2 meters to 0, then display "Stop"; after pressing "OK," the number may switch again, posing a risk of overshooting or failing to reach the correct position. Both flight crew and ground maintenance personnel have encountered this issue on multiple occasions.
translations.text_en: At Stand S126 in Bangkok, the docking guidance frequently changes abruptly: the indicated distance may jump from 2 meters to 0 and then display STOP; after OK is displayed, numbers may appear again. This creates a risk of overshooting or stopping short of the stand position. Both flight crew and maintenance personnel have encountered this repeatedly.
translations.review_note: 逐页核对20261019公司手册对应中英文原文；只修明确误译，保留条件、标识、限制及操作时序。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：02L进近 常指挥保持3 边航向，控制前后机距离，之后 指挥直飞BATEM 或ABVER，在引入02LRNP 进近计划时MCDU会提 示选择VIA BATEM 如果没有选择VIA 计划上看不到BATEM 点。
translations.original_text_en: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.
translations.text_en: On the 02L approach, ATC commonly instructs maintaining the downwind heading to control spacing from aircraft ahead and behind, then directs flight to BATEM or ABVER. When loading the 02LRNP approach, the MCDU prompts selection of VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, BATEM will not appear in the flight plan.
translations.review_note: 逐页核对20261019公司手册对应中英文原文；只修明确误译，保留条件、标识、限制及操作时序。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：我司常停在Satellite-1 卫星厅-1，素万那普有PDC，确 认PDC 之后无需复诵，直接联系地面请求推开指令。停机位对应 的地面频率可以在AMM 图上看到。
translations.original_text_en: Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.
translations.text_en: Company aircraft normally park at Satellite-1 Hall-1. PDC is available at Suvarnabhumi. After confirming PDC, no readback is required; contact ground control directly to request pushback clearance. The ground frequency for the assigned stand is shown on the AMM chart.

translations.text_en: The taxiway is uneven. If the aircraft still cannot taxi out at N1-50%, towing is required.

translations.source_text_zh: 离场：19 号起飞离场一般用Selka1J 离场，起飞后可能 会指挥取消限制直飞Selka，然后可能指挥直飞 SAV。

translations.text_en: Runway 19 departures normally use Selka1J. After takeoff, ATC may cancel restrictions and clear the aircraft direct to Selka, then may clear it direct to SAV.

translations.source_text_zh: 地面：进位跟引导车，地面指挥员为引导车司机，快到位时 应控制速度等司机下车引导。

translations.text_en: Adjust the engine-out acceleration altitude in accordance with fly Smart.

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：VOR08号跑道进近，进场航路可能偏高，注意高距比。程序转弯时管制会指挥下900建立下滑，而程序是700m建立下 滑，可以和管制申请按程序下高度建立下滑。
translations.original_text_en: Approach to Runway 08 (VOR08). The approach path may be ata higher altitude, so monitor the altitude-to-range ratio. During the procedure turn, airtraffic control will direct a 900- meter downward slope, whereas the procedure specifies a 700- meter downward slope. You may request to execute the procedure down slope with the control's approval.
translations.text_en: On the Runway 08 VOR08 approach, the arrival route may leave the aircraft high; monitor the altitude-to-distance relationship. During the procedure turn, ATC may direct descent to establish on the glidepath at 900m, whereas the published procedure establishes it at 700m. You may request ATC approval to descend in accordance with the published procedure and establish on the glidepath.

translations.source_text_zh: 运行特点：三亚停机位301，离场地面滑行阶段，地面指挥A1在B 前等，B没有标志牌，只有地面标识，注意识别和控制滑行速度，尤其夜间滑行，且滑行距离较短，注意慢车时间限制。
translations.original_text_en: At Sanya's apron 301 during ground taxiing, ground controller A1 should wait infront of B. As B has no signage only ground markings, drivers must carefully identify and control taxiing speed—especially at night with shorter taxiing distances—and strictly adhere to the slow-moving vehicle time limit.
translations.text_en: During departure taxi from Stand 301 at Sanya, ground control instructs A1, hold before B. B has no sign, only ground markings. Identify the route carefully and control taxi speed, particularly at night. The taxi distance is short; observe the idle-time limitation.
translations.review_note: 逐页核对20261019公司手册中英文对应原文，纠正运行对象和动作的明确误译，保留所有条件、数值及操作顺序。

translations.source_text_zh: 进场：02L落地后使用F W 跑道外等，使用W 穿越跑道Straight ahead D4 换频 121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线 例如 S123 D 滑行 G 前等，继续滑行 T18 或 T19 进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无 指令，02L 落地后应延 F、W、02R 外等，20R 落地后应延 F、Z、20L外等。
translations.original_text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.
translations.text_en: After landing on 02L, use F and W and hold short of the runway. Cross the runway via W, then continue straight ahead to D4 and change frequency to 121.95. A stand and taxi route will be assigned, for example S123, taxi via D and hold before G, then continue via T18 or T19 to the stand. Stopping on a rapid-exit taxiway after landing on 02L/20R to await taxi instructions is prohibited by aerodrome rules. If no instructions are received, after landing on 02L continue via F and W and hold short of 02R; after landing on 20R continue via F and Z and hold short of 20L.
translations.review_note: 逐页核对20261019公司手册中英文对应原文，纠正运行对象和动作的明确误译，保留所有条件、数值及操作顺序。

translations.source_text_zh: 部分机位推出过程中会临时停下给出启动发动机的指 令，后续会继续牵引飞机，机组应该注意听清指令，不要盲 目刹车，否则有导致剪切销断裂的风险。
translations.original_text_en: Special complex procedures: During the deployment of some aircraft positions, the system may temporarily halt to issue an engine startcommand, after which itwill resume aircraft traction. The crew must carefully heed the instructions and avoid sudden braking, as this could risk shearing pin fracture.
translations.text_en: During pushback from some stands, towing may pause temporarily for an engine-start instruction and then resume. It is advisable to listen carefully to instructions; do not brake indiscriminately, as this may fracture the shear pin.

translations.source_text_zh: 导航设施：SVB 台因迁移长期不工作，已无 VOR 进近程序，盲降测距仪与跑道头位置有误差，避免不稳定。
translations.original_text_en: Navigation facilities: The SVB station has been inactive for an extended period due to relocation, resulting in the absence of VOR approach procedures. The blind landing range finder exhibits positional inaccuracies relative to the runway end, which may cause operational instability.
translations.text_en: The SVB station has been unserviceable for an extended period because of relocation, and VOR approaches are no longer available. The ILS DME reference position differs from the runway threshold position; avoid an unstable approach.

translations.text_en: For final approaches to Runways 13 and 31, maintain a 100-meter margin above the shadow area and do not descend below the minimum safe altitude.
